description: This PHP source file generates a web page for managing LAN Ethernet ports on a gateway device. It includes server-side logic to retrieve device parameters, and client-side JavaScript for user interactions such as enabling/disabling port 4 for XFINITY HOME network. The file also includes HTML markup for displaying port status and configuration options.

methods.name: getPort4XHSEnabled
methods.description: Determines if port 4 is enabled for XFINITY HOME network based on device parameters.

methods.name: NameMap
methods.description: Maps device status strings to user-friendly labels, considering partner ID and WAN enable status.
